remarks: Welcome home to this charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath brick home in Cheektowaga! If you’ve been waiting for a solid brick home with character and convenience, look no further. Features include a beautiful entryway with welcoming natural wood floors throughout the main living area along with wood-burning fireplace for cozy nights. Living/Dining room combo with entry to the eat in kitchen with built in seating. Off the kitchen you spend several mornings or evening in the enclosed sun porch year round along with a private backyard. Major updates include an updated furnace and hot water tank for added peace of mind. The partially finished basement adds extra living or storage space. Situated on a quiet tree-lined street, this home offers easy access to the Kensington Expressway, I-90, grocery stores, restaurants, and major shopping centers — making commuting and daily errands a breeze. While this home isn’t perfect and needs a little TLC, don’t miss the opportunity to own in a convenient Cheektowaga location!
